title: 补上浅蓝窗帘和留白

Scene location: bedroom_window. Keep its fixed layout from the environment anchor.
Visible cast: pipi, diandian; draw each listed character once and no unlisted animals.
Pipi wears the daytime cream shirt, dusty blue short overalls, and blue shoes. Omit the yellow school backpack in this story; it is not mentioned or carried in these scenes. No cap. Diandian is a very small mole, about 0.65 Pipi height, grey-brown round body, tiny eyes, pale pink nose, short rounded paws, beige bib. Slightly squint only when focusing; no glasses.
Single visual moment and acting: 同一幅画新增一条浅蓝垂落窗帘，窗景另一侧留一大片纯白纸，不涂色。
Before: 同一原画含棕框、绿叶和歪月亮；一支浅蓝蜡笔在点点手中。 After: 仅新增一条浅蓝下垂窗帘，并保留大块未着色留白；最终画面资产锁定。
Preserve the same two brown lines, one green leaf and one solid pale-yellow lopsided moon from the reference. Add exactly one narrow pale-blue hanging curtain on the left side of the drawing; keep the marks fixed and most of the paper blank.
For all bedroom shots keep one centered four-pane wooden window, the same pale-green leafy curtain hanging only on the right, one low light-wood desk directly beneath it, and one bed against the left wall. These never shift or multiply. On day scenes, soft natural afternoon light; toward farewell, dusk; bedtime is muted blue night outside with a warm bedside glow. The house is the same warm honey-brown wooden cottage.
Style: gentle hand-painted watercolor on fine warm paper, rounded soft shapes, muted natural color, quiet bedtime picture-book mood. Character expression and eye direction must match the present narration moment, never a fixed neutral or sleepy expression unless the narration says so.
Keep faces and key props in the upper 68% (above the bottom subtitle area); one clear coherent camera composition, no split panels, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no extra windows, no duplicate moons, no extra artwork or unlisted props.
